Game identifier\n * @returns {string}\n */\nfunction getProgressKey(gameId) {\n  return `${PROGRESS_KEY_PREFIX}${gameId}`;\n}\n\n/**\n * Load level progress from storage\n * @param {string} gameId - Game identifier\n * @returns {Object} Progress map: { levelIndex: 'completed'|'skipped' }\n */\nfunction loadProgress(gameId) {\n  return storage.get(getProgressKey(gameId), {});\n}\n\n/**\n * Save level progress to storage\n * @param {string} gameId - Game identifier\n * @param {Object} progress - Progress map\n */\nfunction saveProgress(gameId, progress) {\n  storage.set(getProgressKey(gameId), progress);\n}\n\n/**\n * Get the current level index for a game\n * @param {string} gameId - Game identifier\n * @returns {number} Current level index\n */\nfunction loadCurrentLevel(gameId) {\n  return storage.get(`${PROGRESS_KEY_PREFIX}${gameId}:current`, 0);\n}\n\n/**\n * Save the current level index for a game\n * @param {string} gameId - Game identifier\n * @param {number} index - Current level index\n */\nfunction saveCurrentLevel(gameId, index) {\n  storage.set(`${PROGRESS_KEY_PREFIX}${gameId}:current`, index);\n}\n\n/**\n * Create a level navigation strip\n *\n * @param {Object} options - Total number of hand-crafted levels\n * @param {boolean} options.hasEndless - Whether endless mode follows hand-crafted levels\n * @param {boolean} options.hasDaily - Whether daily challenge is available\n * @param {boolean} options.dailyCompleted - Whether today's daily is completed\n * @param {Function} options.onLevelSelect - Callback(levelIndex) when a level is selected\n * @param {Function} options.onDailySelect - Callback() when daily challenge is tapped\n * @param {Function} options.onEndlessSelect - Callback() when endless mode is tapped\n * @returns {Object} LevelNav instance\n */\nexport function createLevelNav(options = {}) {\n  const {\n    container,\n    gameId = 'default',\n    totalLevels = 1,\n    hasEndless = false,\n    hasDaily = false,\n    dailyCompleted = false,\n    onLevelSelect,\n    onDailySelect,\n    onEndlessSelect,\n  } = options;\n\n  injectPulseKeyframes();\n\n  const progress = loadProgress(gameId);\n  const currentLevel = loadCurrentLevel(gameId);\n\n  // Calculate unlocked levels: all up to and including the highest completed + 1\n  const maxCompleted = Math.max(\n    ...Object.keys(progress)\n      .filter(k => progress[k] === 'completed')\n      .map(Number),\n    -1\n  );\n  const maxUnlocked = Math.min(maxCompleted + 1, totalLevels - 1);\n\n  // Create strip container\n  const strip = document.createElement('div');\n  strip.className = 'mg-level-nav';\n  strip.style.cssText = `\n    position: fixed;\n    bottom: 0;\n    left: 0;\n    right: 0;\n    height: ${STRIP_HEIGHT}px;\n    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85);\n    display: flex;\n    align-items: center;\n    padding: 0 10px;\n    z-index: 500;\n    overflow-x: auto;\n    overflow-y: hidden;\n    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;\n    scrollbar-width: none;\n    touch-action: pan-x;\n  `;\n\n  // Hide scrollbar\n  const scrollbarHider = document.createElement('style');\n  scrollbarHider.textContent = `\n    .mg-level-nav::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }\n    .mg-level-nav { scrollbar-width: none; }\n  `;\n  document.head.appendChild(scrollbarHider);\n\n  const dotsContainer = document.createElement('div');\n  dotsContainer.style.cssText = `\n    display: flex;\n    align-items: center;\n    gap: ${DOT_GAP}px;\n    padding: ${DOT_GAP}px 0;\n    min-width: min-content;\n  `;\n\n  // Daily challenge indicator (left end)\n  if (hasDaily) {\n    const dailyDot = document.createElement('button');\n    dailyDot.className = 'mg-level-dot mg-level-daily';\n    dailyDot.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Daily Challenge');\n    dailyDot.textContent = '\\u2605'; // star\n    dailyDot.style.cssText = `\n      width: ${DOT_SIZE}px;\n      height: ${DOT_SIZE}px;\n      border-radius: 50%;\n      border: 2px solid ${dailyCompleted ? // dash\n    } else {\n      bg = 'transparent';\n      border = '#56B4E9';\n      color = '#56B4E9';\n      content = String(i + 1);\n    }\n\n    dot.style.cssText = `\n      width: ${DOT_SIZE}px;\n      height: ${DOT_SIZE}px;\n      border-radius: 50%;\n      border: 2px solid ${border};\n      background: ${bg};\n      color: ${color};\n      font-size: 11px;\n      font-weight: 600;\n      display: flex;\n      align-items: center;\n      justify-content: center;\n      cursor: ${isLocked ? 'default' : 'pointer'};\n      flex-shrink: 0;\n      transition: transform 0.15s ease;\n      ${isLocked ? 'opacity: 0.5;' : ''}\n    `;\n    dot.textContent = content;\n\n    if (!isLocked) {\n      dot.addEventListener('click', () => {\n        playTap();\n        if (onLevelSelect) {\n          if (isCurrent) {\n            onLevelSelect(currentLevel, true); // true = restart\n          } else {\n            onLevelSelect(i, false);\n          }\n        }\n      });\n    }\n\n    dotsContainer.appendChild(dot);\n  }\n\n  // Endless mode indicator\n  if (hasEndless) {\n    const endlessDot = document.createElement('button');\n    endlessDot.className = 'mg-level-dot mg-level-endless';\n    endlessDot.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Endless Mode');\n    endlessDot.textContent = '\\u221E'; // infinity symbol\n    endlessDot.style.cssText = `\n      width: ${DOT_SIZE}px;\n      height: ${DOT_SIZE}px;\n      border-radius: 50%;\n      border: 2px solid #CC79A7;\n      background: rgba(204, 121, 167, 0.2);\n      color: #CC79A7;\n      font-size: 18px;\n      display: flex;\n      align-items: center;\n      justify-content: center;\n      cursor: pointer;\n      flex-shrink: 0;\n      transition: transform 0.15s ease;\n    `;\n\n    endlessDot.addEventListener('click', () => {\n      playTap();\n      if (onEndlessSelect) onEndlessSelect();\n    });\n\n    dotsContainer.appendChild(endlessDot);\n  }\n\n  strip.appendChild(dotsContainer);\n  container.appendChild(strip);\n\n  // Auto-scroll to current level\n  requestAnimationFrame(() => {\n    const currentDot = dotsContainer.querySelector(`[data-level=\"${currentLevel}\"]`);\n    if (currentDot) {\n      currentDot.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', inline: 'center', block: 'nearest' });\n    }\n  });\n\n  // Build instance\n  const instance = {\n    strip,\n    dotsContainer,\n    gameId,\n    totalLevels,\n    hasEndless,\n    hasDaily,\n\n    /**\n     * Mark a level as completed and advance\n     * @param {number} levelIndex - newTubes[toIdx];\n\n  // Transfer segments\n  const transferred = newFrom.segments.splice(\n    newFrom.segments.length - transferCount,\n    transferCount\n  );\n  newTo.segments.push(...transferred);\n\n  return {\n    ...state,\n    tubes: newTubes,\n    moves: state.moves + 1,\n    selectedTube: null,\n    status: checkWin({ ...state, tubes: newTubes }) ? Game state\n * @returns {boolean}\n */\nexport function checkWin(state) {\n  for (const tube of state.tubes) {\n    if (tube.segments.length === 0) continue;\n    if (tube.segments.length !== state.maxSegments) return false;\n    const color = tube.segments[0];\n    if (!tube.segments.every(s => s === color)) return false;\n  }\n  return true;\n}\n\n/**\n * Get all valid moves for the current state\n *\n * @param {Object} state - 'right' : 'left', distance: Math.abs(cells) };\n  } else {\n    const cells = Math.round(dy / cellSize);\n    if (cells === 0) return null;\n    return { direction: cells > 0 ? 'down' : 'up', distance: Math.abs(cells) };\n  }\n}\n\n// Color utilities\nfunction lighten(hex, pct) {\n  const n = parseInt(hex.replace('#', ''), 16);\n  const a = Math.round(2.55 * pct);\n  const R = Math.min(255, (n >> 16) + a);\n  const G = Math.min(255, ((n >> 8) & 0xff) + a);\n  const B = Math.min(255, (n & 0xff) + a);\n  return `#${(0x1000000 + R * 0x10000 + G * 0x100 + B).toString(16).slice(1)}`;\n}\n\nfunction darken(hex, pct) {\n  const n = parseInt(hex.replace('#', ''), 16);\n  const a = Math.round(2.55 * pct);\n  const R = Math.max(0, (n >> 16) - a);\n  const G = Math.max(0, ((n >> 8) & 0xff) - a);\n  const B = Math.max(0, (n & 0xff) - a);\n  return `#${(0x1000000 + R * 0x10000 + G * 0x100 + B).toString(16).slice(1)}`;\n}\n\n/**\n * Parking Escape Phaser (this.gridGraphics) {\n      this.gridGraphics.destroy();\n    }\n    this.gridGraphics = this.add.graphics();\n\n    const { cellSize, offsetX, offsetY } = this.layout;\n    const gw = 0xffffff, 0.15);\n    this.gridGraphics.strokeRoundedRect(offsetX - 2, offsetY - 2, gridPxW + 4, gridPxH + 4, 10);\n\n    // Asphalt fill with gradient effect\n    const centerX = offsetX + gridPxW / this.gridGraphics.fillRoundedRect(offsetX, offsetY, gridPxW, gridPxH, 8);\n\n    // Subtle gradient overlay\n    this.gridGraphics.fillStyle(0x383838, 0.5);\n    this.gridGraphics.fillRoundedRect(offsetX, offsetY, gridPxW, gridPxH * 0.4, 8);\n\n    // Asphalt grain dots\n    this.gridGraphics.fillStyle(0xffffff, 0.025);\n    for (let c = 0; c < gw; c++) {\n      for (let r = 0; r < gh; r++) {\n        const seed = c * 37 + r * 17;\n        const sx = offsetX + c * cellSize + (seed % 23) / 23 * cellSize;\n        const sy = offsetY + r * cellSize + ((seed * 13) % 31) / 31 * cellSize;\n        this.gridGraphics.fillCircle(sx, sy, 1.5);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Parking space lines (dashed yellow)\n    this.gridGraphics.lineStyle(1.5, 0xffe664, 0.22);\n    for (let c = 1; c < gw; c++) {\n      const x = offsetX + c * cellSize;\n      // Draw dashed line manually\n      for (let y = offsetY + 4; y < offsetY + gridPxH - 4; y += cellSize * 0.5) {\n        const dashLen = cellSize * 0.2;\n        this.gridGraphics.beginPath();\n        this.gridGraphics.moveTo(x, y);\n        this.gridGraphics.lineTo(x, Math.min(y + dashLen, offsetY + gridPxH - 4));\n        this.gridGraphics.strokePath();\n      }\n    }\n    for (let r = 1; r < gh; r++) {\n      const y = offsetY + r * cellSize;\n      for (let x = offsetX + 4; x < offsetX + gridPxW - 4; x += + 4;\n    const exitH = cellSize - 8;\n\n    // Clear border for exit gap\n    this.gridGraphics.clear();\n    this.gridGraphics.fillStyle(0x000000, 0);\n    this.gridGraphics.fillRect(offsetX + this.gridGraphics.lineStyle(2, 0xffffff, 0.15);\n    // Top border\n    this.gridGraphics.beginPath();\n    this.gridGraphics.moveTo(offsetX - 2, offsetY - 2);\n    this.gridGraphics.lineTo(offsetX + gridPxW + 2, offsetY - 2);\n    this.gridGraphics.strokePath();\n    // Left border\n    this.gridGraphics.beginPath();\n    this.gridGraphics.moveTo(offsetX - 2, offsetY - 2);\n    this.gridGraphics.lineTo(offsetX - 2, offsetY + gridPxH + 2);\n    this.gridGraphics.strokePath();\n    // Bottom border\n    this.gridGraphics.beginPath();\n    this.gridGraphics.moveTo(offsetX - 2, offsetY + gridPxH + 2);\n    this.gridGraphics.lineTo(offsetX + gridPxW + 2, offsetY + gridPxH + 2);\n    this.gridGraphics.strokePath();\n    // Right border (with gap for exit)\n    this.gridGraphics.beginPath();\n    this.gridGraphics.moveTo(offsetX + gridPxW + 2, offsetY - 2);\n    this.gridGraphics.lineTo(offsetX + gridPxW + 2, exitY);\n    this.gridGraphics.strokePath();\n    this.gridGraphics.beginPath();\n    this.gridGraphics.moveTo(offsetX + gridPxW + 2, exitY + exitH);\n    this.gridGraphics.lineTo(offsetX + gridPxW + 2, offsetY + gridPxH + 2);\n    this.gridGraphics.strokePath();\n\n    // Asphalt fill\n    this.gridGraphics.fillStyle(0x2a2a2a, 1);\n    this.gridGraphics.fillRoundedRect(offsetX, offsetY, gridPxW, gridPxH, 8);\n    this.gridGraphics.fillStyle(0x383838, 0.5);\n    this.gridGraphics.fillRect(offsetX, offsetY, gridPxW, gridPxH * 0.4);\n\n    // Grain dots\n    this.gridGraphics.fillStyle(0xffffff, 0.025);\n    for (let c = 0; c < gw; c++) {\n      for (let r = 0; r < gh; r++) {\n        const seed = c * 37 + r * 17;\n        const sx = offsetX + c * cellSize + (seed % 23) / 23 * cellSize;\n        const sy = offsetY + r * cellSize + ((seed * 13) % 31) / 31 * cellSize;\n        this.gridGraphics.fillCircle(sx, sy, 1.5);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Parking space lines\n    this.gridGraphics.lineStyle(1.5, 0xffe664, 0.22);\n    for (let c = 1; c < gw; c++) {\n      const x = offsetX + c * cellSize;\n      for (let y = offsetY + 4; y < offsetY + gridPxH - 4; y += cellSize * 0.5) {\n        const dashLen = cellSize * 0.2;\n        this.gridGraphics.beginPath();\n        this.gridGraphics.moveTo(x, y);\n        this.gridGraphics.lineTo(x, Math.min(y + dashLen, offsetY + gridPxH - 4));\n        this.gridGraphics.strokePath();\n      }\n    }\n    for (let r = 1; r < gh; r++) {\n      const y = offsetY + r * cellSize;\n      for (let x = offsetX + 4; x < offsetX + gridPxW - 4; x += cellSize * 0.5) {\n        const dashLen = cellSize * 0.2;\n        this.gridGraphics.beginPath();\n        this.gridGraphics.moveTo(x, y);\n        this.gridGraphics.lineTo(Math.min(x + dashLen, offsetX + gridPxW - 4), y);\n        this.gridGraphics.strokePath();\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Exit glow cone\n    const ax = offsetX + gridPxW + 6;\n    const ay = offsetY + exit.y * cellSize + cellSize / 2;\n\n    const glowGraphics = this.add.graphics();\n    glowGraphics.fillStyle(0xffd700, 0.35);\n    glowGraphics.fillTriangle(\n      ax, ay,\n      ax + cellSize, ay - cellSize / 2,\n      ax + cellSize, ay + cellSize / 2\n    );\n    glowGraphics.fillStyle(0xffd700, 0.15);\n    glowGraphics.fillTriangle(\n      ax, ay,\n      ax + cellSize * 1.5, ay - cellSize * 0.7,\n      ax + cellSize * 1.5, ay + cellSize * 0.7\n    );\n\n    // Exit arrow\n    const arrowGraphics = this.add.graphics();\n    arrowGraphics.fillStyle(0xffd700, 1);\n    arrowGraphics.beginPath();\n    arrowGraphics.moveTo(ax, ay - 9);\n    arrowGraphics.lineTo(ax + 15, ay);\n    arrowGraphics.lineTo(ax, ay + 9);\n    arrowGraphics.closePath();\n    arrowGraphics.fillPath();\n\n    // Arrow glow\n    arrowGraphics.fillStyle(0xffd700, 0.3);\n    arrowGraphics.fillCircle(ax + 7, ay, 18);\n  }\n\n  createVehicleObjects() {\n    // Clear existing vehicle objects\n    this.vehicleGraphics.forEach(g => this.createVehicleGraphics(v);\n    }\n\n    this.updateVehiclePositions();\n  }\n\n  createVehicleGraphics(v) {\n    const { cellSize, offsetX, offsetY } = this.layout;\n    const margin = 4;\n const depth = Math.round(cellSize * 0.10);\n\n    const container = this.add.container(pos.x + margin, pos.y + margin);\n    const graphics = this.add.graphics();\n\n    const isHero = v.type === 'hero';\n\n    // Side face (shadow)\n    const sideColor = Phaser.Display.Color.HexStringToColor(darken(v.color, 30)).color;\n    graphics.fillStyle(sideColor, 1);\n    graphics.fillRoundedRect(depth, depth, pw, ph, r);\n\n    // Top face gradient\n    const topColor = Phaser.Display.Color.HexStringToColor(v.color).color;\n    const lightColor = graphics.fillStyle(topColor, 1);\n    graphics.fillRoundedRect(0, 0, pw, ph, r);\n\n    // Gradient overlay (top highlight)\n    graphics.fillStyle(lightColor, 0.4);\n    graphics.fillRoundedRect(0, 0, pw, ph * 0.5, r);\n\n    // Border\n    graphics.lineStyle(1.5, 0xffffff, 0.22);\n    graphics.strokeRoundedRect(0, 0, pw, ph, r);\n\n    // Top highlight strip\n    graphics.fillStyle(0xffffff, 0.28);\n    graphics.fillRoundedRect(4, 3, pw - 8, ph * 0.22, r * 0.5);\n\n    // Windows\n    graphics.fillStyle(0xc8f0ff, 0.35);\n    if (v.orientation === 'horizontal') {\n      const ww = pw * 0.28;\n      const wh = ph * 0.38;\n      const wy = ph * 0.2;\n      graphics.fillRect(pw * 0.1, wy, ww, wh);\n      graphics.fillRect(pw * 0.62, wy, ww, wh);\n    } else {\n      const ww = pw * 0.52;\n      const wh = ph * 0.14;\n      const wx = pw * 0.24;\n      graphics.fillRect(wx, ph * 0.1, ww, wh);\n      if (v.height >= 3) graphics.fillRect(wx, ph * 0.45, ww, wh);\n    }\n\n    // Windshield glare\n    graphics.fillStyle(0xffffff, 0.12);\n    if (v.orientation === 'horizontal') {\n      graphics.beginPath();\n      graphics.moveTo(pw * 0.1, ph * 0.2);\n      graphics.lineTo(pw * 0.38, ph * 0.2);\n      graphics.lineTo(pw * 0.28, ph * 0.58);\n      graphics.lineTo(pw * 0.1, ph * 0.58);\n      graphics.closePath();\n      graphics.fillPath();\n    } else {\n      graphics.beginPath();\n      graphics.moveTo(pw * 0.24, ph * 0.1);\n      graphics.lineTo(pw * 0.76, ph * 0.1);\n      graphics.lineTo(pw * 0.65, ph * 0.24);\n      graphics.lineTo(pw * 0.24, ph * 0.24);\n      graphics.closePath();\n      graphics.fillPath();\n    }\n\n    // Hero glow\n    if (isHero) {\n      const glowGraphics = this.add.graphics();\n      glowGraphics.lineStyle(3, 0xe74c3c, 0.5);\n      glowGraphics.strokeRoundedRect(-4, -4, pw + 8, ph + 8, r + 2);\n      container.add(glowGraphics);\n    }\n\n    container.add(graphics);\n    this.vehicleContainers.set(v.id, container);\n    this.vehicleGraphics.set(v.id, graphics);\n  }\n\n  updateVehiclePositions() {\n    for (const v of this.state.vehicles) {\n      const container = this.vehicleContainers.get(v.id);\n      if (!container) continue;\n\n      const margin = 4;\n      const pos = gridToCanvas(v.x, v.y, this.layout);\n      container.setPosition(pos.x + margin, pos.y + margin);\n\n      // Bring hero to top\n      if (v.type === 'hero') {\n        container.setDepth(10);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  setupInput() {\n    this.input.on('pointerdown', (pointer) => {\n      if (this.state.status !== 'playing') return;\n\n      const vehicleId = hitTestVehicleAt(pointer.x, pointer.y, this.state, this.layout);\n      if (!vehicleId) return;\n\n      const vehicle = this.state.vehicles.find(v => v.id === vehicleId);\n      if (!vehicle) return;\n\n      this.drag = {\n        vehicleId,\n        axis: vehicle.orientation === 'horizontal' ? 'x' : 'y',\n        startX: pointer.x,\n        startY: pointer.y,\n        currentDx: 0,\n        currentDy: 0\n      };\n\n      // Bring dragged vehicle to top\n      const container = this.vehicleContainers.get(vehicleId);\n      if (container) {\n        container.setDepth(100);\n      }\n\n      if (this.onDragStart) {\n        this.onDragStart(vehicleId);\n      }\n    });\n\n    this.input.on('pointermove', (pointer) => {\n      if (!this.drag) return;\n\n      this.drag.currentDx = this.drag.axis === 'x' ? pointer.x - this.drag.startX : 0;\n      this.drag.currentDy = this.drag.axis === 'y' ? pointer.y - this.drag.startY : 0;\n\n      // Update vehicle position visually\n      const container = this.vehicleContainers.get(this.drag.vehicleId);\n      const vehicle = this.state.vehicles.find(v => v.id === this.drag.vehicleId);\n      if (container && vehicle) {\n        const margin = 4;\n        const pos = gridToCanvas(vehicle.x, vehicle.y, this.layout);\n        container.setPosition(\n          pos.x + margin + this.drag.currentDx,\n          pos.y + margin + this.drag.currentDy\n        );\n      }\n\n      if (this.onDragMove) {\n        this.onDragMove(this.drag.vehicleId, this.drag.currentDx, this.drag.currentDy);\n      }\n    });\n\n    this.input.on('pointerup', (pointer) => {\n      if (!this.drag) return;\n\n      const vehicle = this.state.vehicles.find(v => v.id === this.drag.vehicleId);\n      if (vehicle && this.onDragEnd) {\n        this.onDragEnd(this.drag.vehicleId, this.drag.currentDx, this.drag.currentDy);\n      }\n\n      this.drag = null;\n    });\n  }\n\n  setState(newState) {\n    this.state = newState;\n    this.updateLayout();\n    this.drawGrid();\n    this.createVehicleObjects();\n  }\n\n  setReducedMotion(value) {\n    this.reducedMotion = value;\n  }\n\n  setHintVehicle(vehicleId) {\n    // Clear existing hint tweens\n    this.hintTweens.forEach(tween => tween.stop());\n    this.hintTweens.clear();\n\n    this.hintVehicleId = vehicleId;\n\n    if (vehicleId !== null && !this.reducedMotion) {\n      const container = this.vehicleContainers.get(vehicleId);\n      const     this.vehicleContainers.forEach((container, id) => {\n        container.setAlpha(1);\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  render(state, drag, selectedId) {\n    this.state = state;\n    this.drag = drag;\n    this.selectedId = selectedId;\n\n    // Update vehicle positions\n    for (const v of state.vehicles) {\n      const container = this.vehicleContainers.get(v.id);\n      if (!container) {\n        this.createVehicleGraphics(v);\n        continue;\n      }\n\n      const margin = 4;\n      let pos = gridToCanvas(v.x, v.y, this.layout);\n      let offsetX = 0;\n      let offsetY = 0;\n\n      // Apply drag offset\n      if (drag && drag.vehicleId === v.id) {\n        offsetX = drag.dx || 0;\n        offsetY = drag.dy || 0;\n      }\n\n      container.setPosition(pos.x + margin + offsetX, pos.y + margin + offsetY);\n\n      // Selection highlight\n      const isSelected = selectedId === v.id || (drag && drag.vehicleId === v.id);\n      if (isSelected) {\n        container.setDepth(100);\n      } else if (v.type === 'hero') {\n        container.setDepth(10);\n      } else {\n        container.setDepth(1);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Win overlay\n    if (state.status === 'won') {\n      if (!this.winOverlay) {\n        this.winOverlay = this.add.graphics();\n        this.winOverlay.setDepth(1000);\n      }\n      this.winOverlay.clear();\n      this.winOverlay.fillStyle(0x000000, 0.35);\n      this.winOverlay.fillRect(0, 0, this.scale.width, this.scale.height);\n    } else if (this.winOverlay) {\n      this.winOverlay.clear();\n    }\n  }\n\n  animateSlide(vehicleId, fromGridX, fromGridY, toGridX, toGridY, cells) {\n    if (this.reducedMotion) return;\n\n    const container = this.vehicleContainers.get(vehicleId);\n    if (!container) return;\n\n    // Stop existing tween for this vehicle\n    const existingTween = this.slideTweens.get(vehicleId);\n    if (existingTween) existingTween.stop();\n\n    const { cellSize } = this.layout;\n    const margin = 4;\n    const targetPos = gridToCanvas(toGridX, toGridY, this.layout);\n\n    this.slideTweens.set(vehicleId, this.tweens.add({\n      targets: container,\n      x: this.slideTweens.delete(vehicleId);\n      }\n    }));\n  }\n\n  shake(durationMs = 300, amplitude = 4) {\n    if (this.reducedMotion) return;\n\n    // Stop existing shake\n    if (this.shakeTween) this.shakeTween.stop();\n\n    const cam = this.cameras.main;\n    const originalX = cam.scrollX;\n    const originalY = cam.scrollY;\n\n    this.shakeTween = this.tweens.add({\n      targets: cam,\n      scrollX: originalX + amplitude,\n      scrollY: originalY + amplitude,\n      duration: 50,\n      yoyo: true,\n      repeat: Math.floor(durationMs / 100),\n      ease: 'Sine.easeInOut',\n      onComplete: () => {\n        cam.scrollX = originalX;\n        cam.scrollY = originalY;\n      }\n    });\n  }\n\n  onHeroExit(exitRow) {\n    if (this.reducedMotion) return;\n\n    const { cellSize, offsetX, offsetY } = this.layout;\n    const x = offsetX + (6 * cellSize) + 20;\n    const y = offsetY + exitRow * cellSize + cellSize / 2;\n\n    const colors = [0xe74c3c, 0xffd700, 0xffffff, 0xff8c42, 0xff3cac];\n\n    // Create particle emitter\n    const particles = this.add.particles(x, y, null, {\n      speed: { min: 100, max: 300 },\n      angle: { min: 0, max: 360 },\n      scale: { start: 0.5, end: 0 },\n      lifespan: 800,\n      quantity: 40,\n      emitting: false\n    });\n\n    // Emit burst\n    particles.explode(40);\n\n    // Create manual particles since we don't have a texture\n    for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {\n      const color = colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)];\n      const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;\n      const speed = 100 + Math.random() * 200;\n      const size = 4 + Math.random() * 6;\n\n      const particle = this.add.graphics();\n      particle.fillStyle(color, 1);\n      particle.fillRect(-size / 2, -size / 2, size, size * 0.75);\n      particle.setPosition(x, y);\n      particle.setRotation(Math.random() * Math.PI * 2);\n      particle.setDepth(500);\n\n      this.tweens.add({\n        targets: particle,\n        x: x + Math.cos(angle) * speed,\n        y: y + Math.sin(angle) * speed - 100,\n        alpha: 0,\n        rotation: particle.rotation + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2,\n        duration: 800 + Math.random() * 400,\n        ease: 'Quad.easeOut',\n        onComplete: () => particle.destroy()\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  resize(state) {\n    this.state = state;\n    this.updateLayout();\n    this.drawGrid();\n    this.createVehicleObjects();\n  }\n\n  // API methods for external access\n  hitTestVehicle(px, py) {\n    return hitTestVehicleAt(px, py, this.state, this.layout);\n  }\n\n  computeSnapMove(vehicle, dx, dy) {\n    return computeSnapMoveFromDelta(vehicle, dx, dy, this.layout.cellSize);\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Create renderer instance - returns Phaser game and API\n */\nexport function createRenderer(canvas) {\n  let game = null;\n  let scene = null;\n  let lastState = null;\n  let reducedMotion = false;\n  let hintVehicleId = null;\n  let pendingCallbacks = {};\n  let gameReady = false;\n  let sceneStarted = false;\n\n  const gameConfig = {\n    type: Phaser.AUTO,\n    scale: {\n      mode: Phaser.Scale.FIT,\n      autoCenter: Phaser.Scale.CENTER_BOTH,\n      width: 390,\n      height: 844,\n      parent: canvas.parentElement,\n      canvas: canvas\n    },\n    backgroundColor: '#1a1a2e',\n    transparent: true\n  };\n\n  function maybeStartScene() {\n    if (!gameReady || !lastState || sceneStarted) return;\n    sceneStarted = true;\n    game.scene.add('ParkingEscapeScene', ParkingEscapeScene, true, {\n      state: lastState,\n      reducedMotion,\n      ...pendingCallbacks\n    });\n  }\n\n  function init() {\n    game = new Phaser.Game(gameConfig);\n    game.events.once('ready', () => {\n      gameReady = true;\n      maybeStartScene();\n    });\n  }\n\n  function getScene() {\n    if (!scene) {\n      scene = game.scene.getScene('ParkingEscapeScene');\n    }\n    return scene;\n  }\n\n  function resize(state) {\n    lastState = state;\n    maybeStartScene();\n    const s = getScene();\n    if (s && s.scene.isActive()) {\n      s.resize(state);\n    }\n  }\n\n  function render(state, drag, selectedId) {\n    lastState = state;\n    maybeStartScene();\n    const s = getScene();\n    if (s && s.scene.isActive()) {\n      s.render(state, drag, selectedId);\n    }\n  }\n\n  function hitTestVehicle(px, py, state) {\n    const s =
